scope: Local complete guarded native gate for the bounded POST-JSON transport primitive. HTTP/TLS peers, provider replies, credentials and usage are synthetic; actual native socket transport is exercised.

source.hash_mode: Exact frozen file bytes; no source normalization.

prior_cases.comparison: Remove only POST fixture additions; compare exact 2cd test text after CRLF to LF. Frozen/current file hashes are raw bytes.

design_document.scope: Separate design proposal; its evolving text is not compiled input or evidence of implemented compaction.

runtime.scope: Five existing accepted local SDK runtime/link/module files were hash verified. This is not an SDK change or benchmark/performance acceptance.

first_attempt.scope: Guard-only retained first attempt; no native build/test evidence exists for this attempt.

passing_gate.scope: All registered 78 native contracts passed with no excluded or skipped tests against the frozen inputs.

last_test_capture.scope: Full native LastTest was copied before CTest discovery. It contains the passing transport stdout, but no independently emitted POST counter/request audit.

transport_contract.name: native_http_stream_transport_contract
transport_contract.proof_scope: Source-bound exact request/header/body/response assertions were reached by the successful native transport contract. No independent raw peer counter or request audit was retained.
scenarios: Three selected credential headers and Anthropic protocol version
Exact response byte boundary and independent response above GET 1 MiB cap
Raw decimal/escaped request lexemes and UTF-8 body/response bytes with split code point writes
Overflow, media rejection and unfollowed redirect
Cancellation, deadline, idle timeout, untrusted TLS and preflight rejection

evidence_publisher.scope: File-only hash checks and byte-copy publication. No Git, native, SDK, peer, SQL, HTTP, provider credentials or installed process execution.

excluded_claims: Independent retained raw POST peer request audit
